Subject: Rollout RSVP timebox and ops backstop — final playbook sync

Hi Priya / Alex,

Thanks again for the trial feedback this week — were ready to lock in the final rollout ops call to validate cutover owners, backout windows, and fallback policies before your production switch. To make scheduling simple, please pick one of the timeboxes below (all PT):

- Option A: Tue May 4, 10:00–10:45 AM PT
- Option B: Wed May 5, 2:00–2:45 PM PT
- Option C: Thu May 6, 3:00–3:45 PM PT

Proposed agenda (30–45 min):
- Rollout sequence & blackout windows (10 min)
- Cutover owners & rollback criteria (10 min)
- Fallback routing and SLA expectations (5 min)
- Action items & signoffs (10 min)

Attached is the current playbook draft for context. Marcus will lead the runbook walkthrough; Monica will cover success criteria and post-cutover validation. If procurement or security needs to join, please add them here — we can keep the call focused on engineering + ops with separate procurement checklist follow-up if preferred.

Thanks — looking for a quick RSVP so we can lock a calendar and get DocuSign queued if needed.

Best,
Jordan Blake
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
[jordan.blake@redwood.com]

Jordan — thanks for sending. A couple of constraints from our side: procurement needs 48 hours to process the final SOW and procurement redlines (we are aiming to have signatures complete before the commit window), and our security team (ccd) wants a short artifacts list (SOC2 scope, retained logs, and minimal network flow diagram) before the ops call so they can confirm firewall rules.

Given that, can we move to the week of May 10? I have two preferred windows (PT):
- Mon May 10, 2:00–2:45 PM PT
- Tue May 11, 3:00–3:45 PM PT

If May 10 works for Redwood, Marcus / Jordan, can you confirm SE availability and who will be the rollback owner? Ill also loop in procurement for the DocuSign link once we confirm the call time.

—Priya

Thanks Priya — we can do Mon May 10 at 2:00 PM PT. Confirming SE availability and proposing the following operational owners so responsibilities are explicit:

- Cutover owner: Marcus Lin (SE) — will coordinate traffic cutover and KV cache priming
- Rollback owner: Stephanie Nguyen (Infra Ops) — will execute backstop and revert routing if criteria met
- Validation lead: Monica Patel (Customer Success) — will run smoke-checks and acceptance checklist

Ive attached a one-page contacts list for the rollback roster (internal Redis/infra contacts + escalation numbers). Marcus will cover the runbook section and can run a 10-min dry-run with your network team if helpful before the window.

Short note on fallback policy: our default is to route to the previous model endpoint for 15 minutes on partial failures; full rollback requires manual approval from your SRE + our Rollback owner. We will document exact failure thresholds in the call.

Thanks — Marcus
